about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/syntax: edits of the parser's derived forms that the package's tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/syntax; a unit that cannot afford the coverage pass applies each edit by hand and runs the killer. Seeded by wf10 batch-15 fix-r2 (L11b M1).

mutants.name: l11b-s1
mutants.to:
d := types[name]
	if true || d == nil ||
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: the round-trip law of an open X draws x itself.

mutants.name: l11b-inline-variant-closed
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: a union of inline records of exported fields is open, so its law draws x.

mutants.name: l11b-unexported-field-open
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 7: a record with an unexported field is built only by its package; its law draws b through ParseX.

mutants.name: try1-groups-right
mutants.rule: grammar.md Expressions 1 (q105): a try in operand position wraps its operand only; it adds no grouping.
